items.fix: Who was this book written by?
items.why: Use was + participle and by at the end.

items.wrong: The book was wrote by a woman.

facts.big: Who was / were + sujeito + particípio + by?
facts.label: Pergunta com Who … by
facts.sub: Pergunta: Who was it written by? Resposta: It was written by… Plural: Who were these songs sung by? Particípios: written, sung, composed.

facts.label: Foi escrito por
facts.sub: Use was written by para livros, poemas e músicas. It was written by an Irish writer. O particípio de write é written, não wrote nem writed. Para plural: were written by.

facts.label: Por quem?
facts.sub: Para perguntar quem fez, coloque by no fim: Who was this book written by? Who were these songs sung by? Não use did nem outro auxiliar.

facts.label: Foi traduzido
facts.sub: Use was translated para livros e textos em outra língua. Many books are translated into Portuguese. The poem was translated into French. Atenção ao particípio translated.

facts.label: Foi composto
facts.sub: Use was composed by para músicas. The music was composed by a local band. Para letras, use written; para a voz, use sung: The song was sung by a girl.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: “Who was this book written by?” is correct.
We say “Who did this book written by?”
items.why: We say Who was this book written by?

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.

extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: “Who was this book written by?” is correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “Who did this book written by?” → Falso (We say Who was this book written by?)
“Written by” can answer the question. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A rainy day in a Dublin library · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a rainy Thursday afternoon in Dublin. Dirk and Bia walk into a big old library. Every shelf is full of books, and the room smells of paper. Dirk wants a book for a class project. Bia knows many Irish writers and songs. They look at the covers one by one.
“Bia, who was this book written by? I don’t see the name.” says Dirk. “It was written by an Irish writer. Her name is on the back.” says Bia. “Was it made into a film?” says Dirk.

paragraphs: “I’m not sure. The name was printed on the ticket, I think.” says Bia. “Let’s ask the librarian. She knows who it was written by.” says Dirk. The librarian smiles and walks to their table. She shows them the book and the poem. Dirk writes the names of the writers in his notebook. Bia borrows two books for the weekend. Outside, the rain stops, and the street shines. Now they know who the stories were written by.
